'''Bobi''' was a street orphan on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. After trying to [[Thief/Legends|steal]] [[Chop Harlison]]'s [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] box, Bobi was taken under the mechanic's wing as he saw himself in the boy. Bobi found a home in the [[Rabid Mynocks]] and wears the gang's colors while waiting for the day that he is grown up enough to ride a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]].<ref name="SG" />
